city.Tunisia.description: Tunisia sits at the northern tip of Africa, facing the Mediterranean Sea. It is famous for the ancient ruins of Carthage, sandy Sahara deserts used as film sets for Star Wars, and the giant Roman amphitheater at El Jem.

city.Tunisia.greeting: In Arabic, hello is “Aslema” (as-LEH-ma) in Tunisia.

city.Uganda.description: This green, landlocked country in East Africa is famous for the misty forests where mountain gorillas live, the powerful Nile River, and deep lakes dotted with terraced green islands.
city.Uganda.landmark: Nile bursting through the narrow rocky gorge of Murchison Falls into a misty pool
city.Uganda.greeting: In Luganda, hello is “Oli otya?” (oh-lee OH-tyah), which asks how you are.

city.Zambia.description: This landlocked country in Southern Africa shares the thundering Victoria Falls, holds one of the world's largest human-made lakes, and digs huge amounts of shiny copper from its red earth.
city.Zambia.landmark: thundering curtain of Victoria Falls with mist and a rainbow
city.Zambia.greeting: In the Bemba language, hello is “Muli shani?” (moo-lee SHAH-nee).
city.Zambia.flag: sketched a green flag with red, black, and orange stripes in one corner and an orange eagle above them
city.Zambia.clue.0: kept talking about a giant waterfall with a natural pool right on its dangerous, splashing edge
city.Zambia.clue.1: boasted about touring mines where workers dig up shiny orange copper
city.Zimbabwe.description: This landlocked country in Southern Africa is named after Great Zimbabwe, an ancient stone city built without any mortar, and it shares the thundering Victoria Falls with its neighbor. Its money once grew so wobbly that it famously printed a single hundred-trillion-dollar banknote before switching to other currencies.
city.Zimbabwe.landmark: ancient curved stone walls and conical tower of the Great Zimbabwe ruins
city.Zimbabwe.greeting: In the Shona language, hello is “Mhoro” (MMOH-roh).
city.Zimbabwe.flag: traced a flag with green, yellow, red, and black stripes and a golden bird on a white triangle
city.Zimbabwe.clue.0: kept reading about an ancient city of huge stone walls stacked together without any mortar
